title: Lớp 9 — Đề Kiểm Tra Giữa Học Kỳ I (50 Câu Luyện Thi Vào 10)

questions.stem_text: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án D: The letter a in make is /eɪ/; the others are /æ/.

questions.stem_text: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án D: The ea in teach is /i:/; the others have /e/.

questions.stem_text: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: The ow in slow is /əʊ/; the others have /aʊ/.

questions.stem_text: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án C: The ear in near sounds different from the vowel in bear, wear and pear.

questions.stem_text: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: The i in city is /ɪ/; the others are /aɪ/.

questions.stem_text: A person who makes beautiful things by hand is an _____.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án D: An artisan makes handicraft items.

questions.stem_text: My grandmother _____ this traditional recipe to my mother.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: Hand down means pass knowledge from an older generation.

questions.stem_text: We do not know _____ to buy handmade lanterns.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: Where to buy expresses the unknown place.

questions.stem_text: The metro is a kind of public _____.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: The metro is public transport.

questions.stem_text: Many streets are _____ during rush hour.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: Congested means full of traffic.

questions.stem_text: You should _____ the time you spend on your phone before bed.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: Cut down on means reduce.

questions.stem_text: If you feel stressed, you _____ talk to someone you trust.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: Should gives advice in the main clause.

questions.stem_text: The young artists are proud _____ their local crafts.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án D: The correct collocation is proud of.

questions.stem_text: A quiet room helps students _____ on their homework.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án C: Concentrate on means pay attention to.

questions.stem_text: Tourists come to the village to buy handmade _____.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án C: Souvenirs are items kept as memories of a visit.

questions.stem_text: The _____ you plan your day, the more free time you may have.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: Use the + comparative in a double comparative.

questions.stem_text: We are not sure _____ to reach the craft village by bus.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: How to reach means by what method or route.

questions.stem_text: If our team finishes early, we _____ join the community fair.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án D: A modal verb takes the base form: can join.

questions.stem_text: The _____ of living downtown is usually high.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án D: Cost of living refers to living expenses.

questions.stem_text: He came _____ a cold after the school trip.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: Come down with means become ill with.

questions.stem_text: The _____ the buses are, the more people will use them.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án C: Double comparative: the more reliable..., the more....

questions.stem_text: The city council is _____ a plan to make the streets safer.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: Carry out a plan means put it into action.

questions.stem_text: Could you show me _____ to make this paper lantern?
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: How to make asks about the method.

questions.stem_text: If you do not get enough sleep, you _____ feel tired the next day.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án C: May expresses a possible result in type 1 conditional.

questions.stem_text: Teenagers need to _____ study time and leisure time.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: Balance means give suitable time to both.

questions.stem_text: Lan: "Would you like me to show you around our town?"  Ben: "_____"
options: No, the town is very small.
Yes, please. That would be lovely.
written_answers: Yes, please. That would be lovely.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: A polite acceptance of an offer.

questions.stem_text: Mai: "I feel worried about tomorrow's exam."  Ha: "_____"
options: It is too late to learn anything.
You should take a short break and revise calmly.
You should stay awake all night.
written_answers: You should take a short break and revise calmly.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án C: Supportive, realistic advice for exam stress.

questions.stem_text: Visitor: "Excuse me, how can I get to the bus station?"  Local: "_____"
options: Go straight on and turn left at the traffic lights.
There are many buses in my city.
written_answers: Go straight on and turn left at the traffic lights.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án C: The response gives directions.

questions.stem_text: Hoa: "Thanks for helping me carry the books."  Nam: "_____"
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: You are welcome responds to thanks.

questions.stem_text: Teacher: "Would you mind closing the door?"  Student: "_____"
options: I am not sure where it is.
Not at all. I will close it now.
written_answers: Not at all. I will close it now.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án D: Not at all politely accepts a request.

questions.stem_text: What does this sign mean?
options: You must not drop rubbish here.
You should bring more bags here.
written_answers: You must not drop rubbish here.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: No littering prohibits dropping rubbish.

questions.stem_text: What must students do according to this sign?
options: Stand in the middle of the corridor.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án C: Keep to the right refers to the side used while walking.

questions.stem_text: What has changed about the English Club meeting?
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: Only the day changes from Thursday to Friday.

questions.stem_text: What should visitors do before joining the workshop?
options: Book a place before joining the workshop.
Bring their own clay to enter.
written_answers: Book a place before joining the workshop.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: Booking is required means advance registration is necessary.

questions.stem_text: What may a 15-year-old library member do?
options: Borrow five books for a month.
Borrow two books for up to 14 days.
written_answers: Borrow two books for up to 14 days.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: The notice gives both a quantity and a time limit.

questions.stem_text: Who first taught Ms Hoa the craft?
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: The text states she learned it from her grandmother.

questions.stem_text: What does Ms Hoa do immediately after shaping the clay?
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: The steps are shape, dry, then paint.

questions.stem_text: Why do many visitors like the handmade bowls?
options: They are made in a factory.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án C: Different handmade bowls are unique.

questions.stem_text: When must teenagers book for a Saturday session?
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án C: The deadline is Friday evening.

questions.stem_text: What can be inferred about the workshop fee?
options: All of it is paid to tourists.
It also supports children in the community.
It is used to buy city buses.
written_answers: It also supports children in the community.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: Part of the fee funds free art lessons.

questions.stem_text: What problem did Minh have after moving?
options: He had difficulty sleeping because of the noise.
He could not find any sports centre.
He had no shops near his home.
written_answers: He had difficulty sleeping because of the noise.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: Noise was affecting his sleep.

questions.stem_text: What did Minh change about his phone use?
options: He used it more during the night.
He stopped using it one hour before bed.
He left it on all night.
written_answers: He stopped using it one hour before bed.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án C: He put the phone away one hour before bedtime.

questions.stem_text: Who did Minh talk to when he felt anxious?
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án D: The passage explicitly mentions his parents.

questions.stem_text: What happened after several weeks?
options: He slept better and focused more easily.
He spent less time at school.
written_answers: He slept better and focused more easily.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án C: The positive change is in sleep and attention.

questions.stem_text: Which is the best title for the passage?
options: Why Every City Is Too Noisy
A Guide to Buying a Phone
How to Open a Sports Centre
Small Habits for a Healthier Life
written_answers: Small Habits for a Healthier Life
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án D: The whole text focuses on practical healthy habits.

questions.stem_text: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "I do not know which bus I should take."
options: I know that I should take every bus.
I do not know which bus to take.
I do not know which bus taking.
I do not know which to bus take.
written_answers: I do not know which bus to take.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: Wh-word + to-infinitive replaces which bus I should take.

questions.stem_text: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "As the roads get busier, journeys take longer."
options: The busy the roads get, the long journeys take.
The busiest the roads get, the longest journeys take.
The roads are busier, journeys are longest.
The busier the roads get, the longer journeys take.
written_answers: The busier the roads get, the longer journeys take.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án D: Double comparative pairs busier with longer.

questions.stem_text: They are "carrying out" a survey about public transport. What does the phrase mean?
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án D: Carry out a survey = conduct a survey.

questions.stem_text: Choose the grammatically correct sentence.
options: If she finishes early, she can join the club.
If she will finish early, she can joins the club.
If she finish early, she can joining the club.
If she finished early, she can to join the club.
written_answers: If she finishes early, she can join the club.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: Conditional type 1 uses present simple after if; modal + base verb.

questions.stem_text: Complete the idea: "The more people travel by bicycle, _____ pollution the city may have."
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án D: Pollution is uncountable; the less expresses a reduction.
